genre: 安全工程 safety-engineering（分类学型）
move_sequence: CONTEXT(监控理念与目标) → CONTEXT(系统机制: GPT-5.4 Thinking 驱动/30 分钟内复审) → ARGUE(初步结果: 覆盖全部员工上报) → ARGUE(诚实声明: 未见 scheming 证据 + <0.1% 盲区) → APPLY(分类学主体: 六类错位行为定义+实例+频率标签) → CLOSE

moves.evidence_excerpt: we believe monitoring agentic behavior...will become an increasingly important safety tool
powered by GPT-5.4 Thinking at maximum reasoning effort
so far we have not seen evidence of...scheming
Category overview: definition + observations + frequency label

argument.evidence_types: 监控系统性能（对照员工上报）+ 行为实例清单（别名 force push/base64 编码）+ 频率标签体系
argument.source_tier: self 全部内部部署观察
argument.qualifiers: may / might / seems / a very small fraction (<0.1%) / Common refers to less than 1%——频率标签本身带操作化定义
argument.rebuttals: 主动声明未发现 scheming 证据（不渲染威胁）；监控覆盖盲区自曝

style_notes: 分类学型安全文：正文主体是六类错位行为的定义-实例-频率三元组（Circumventing restrictions / Deception / Concealing uncertainty / Requesting unnecessary confirmations…）；每类先中性定义再给真实实例；频率标签带操作化定义（Common = <1%）——与 gdpval 的 60% 阈值同属'把模糊概念定量化'的家族风格；隐私承诺前置（only to surface problematic behaviors in narrowly-scoped ways）
